text:
We can confirm that the annual Larkmere kite festival is hosted in Astley Down, where the event has settled into the town’s late-summer calendar. This year’s gathering ran on 17–18 August across the North Mere fields, drawing 2,400 visitors and 61 registered flyers. Organisers at the Vale Aeration Society said the relocation to Astley Down improved wind consistency and reduced setup delays by 18 minutes on average.

Key facts:
- Host town: Astley Down
- Festival name: Larkmere kite festival
- Dates: 17–18 August
- Attendance: 2,400
- Registered participants: 61
- Noted change: shorter rigging times due to steadier crosswinds

Local vendors reported stronger footfall than in the previous lakefront venue.
